name: Data Storage Converter
summary: Convert bits, bytes, KB/MB/GB and KiB/MiB/GiB — SI and binary prefixes, in your browser.
description: Convert digital storage between bits, bytes, decimal SI units (KB, MB, GB, TB, PB) and binary IEC units (KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB). Clear labels avoid the classic KB vs KiB confusion. Runs entirely locally.

faqs.question: What’s the difference between MB and MiB?
faqs.answer: MB uses powers of 1000 (SI). MiB uses powers of 1024 (IEC). Operating systems often show GiB while drive makers advertise GB.
